programme.title: Epic Movie

programme.title: Gi' den hele armen

programme.title: Cement i armen

programme.title: Krudt og klunker

programme.title: Den Sidste Vinter

programme.title: Farvel til mafiaen

programme.title: 24 Hours to Live

programme.title: Notorious

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Vickie Berlin taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at blive sat i bås som ”den sjove”, rollen i Triangle of Sadness, Cannes og Oscar – og om hvorfor man aldrig må holde op med at drømme og sætte nye ting på sin bucketliste.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Irina Draga taler med Kenny Aleksandr om vejen fra reality-tv til influencer og iværksætter, om skønhed, moderskab og livet bag den polerede facade – og om at tage kontrollen over sin egen fortælling.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Ellen Hillingsø om skønhed, alder og kunsten at leve livet fuldt ud. Hos Kenny Aleksandr fortæller hun om rynker, røde løbere, beautyfavoritter og sin nye bog – og hvorfor livet kun bliver sjovere, når vi tør være os selv.

programme.title: One of the Girls - med Kenny Aleksandr
programme.desc: Szhirley taler med Kenny Aleksandr om at fylde 50, perimenopause, Botox og CO2-laser, kropsidealer og sociale medier – og om samtidig at kunne se sig selv i spejlet og sige: “Jeg elsker mig.”

programme.title: Seraphim Falls
programme.desc: Fem år efter den amerikanske borgerkrig rammes en nedslidt mand i en lysning af et skud i skulderen. Han flygter, og oberst Morsman Carver træder frem. Han er ude efter hævn, og det bliver en jagt, der fører de to mænd vidt omkring i Amerika.

programme.title: Texas Killing Fields
programme.desc: Langt inde i de dybeste afkroge af Texas støder en lokal politimand og hans nye makker fra New York på spor, der vækker ubehagelige minder om en uløst sag om seriemord. Det umage makkerpar forsøger at løse de gamle gåder.

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: Intet kunne forberede den barske undergrund i Liverpool på den kilt-klædte, designerdrug-handlende Elmo McElroy, der har brændt mere end broer bag sig i L.A.

programme.title: 12 Runde 3 Lockdown
programme.desc: WWE-superstjernen Dean Ambrose spiller Shaw, en etterforsker som vender tilbake til aktiv tjeneste, etter at partneren døde. Da han avdekker bevis som forbinder kollegene til et mord, setter de ham fast for et drap han ikke har begått.

programme.title: A Good Man
programme.desc: Efter en hæderkronet karriere i specialstyrken, træder Alexander ud rampelyset for at leve et stille liv. Men da en af hans lejere rager uklar med en gangster, bliver Alexander trukket ind en krig mellem kinesiske og russiske bander.

programme.title: You Will Meet a Tall Dark Stranger
programme.desc: Woody Allen er tilbage i formidabel form med en vittig og begavet storbykomedie om to generationers passioner, kriser og fortumlede forsøg på at finde lykken.

programme.title: Now Add Honey
programme.desc: Carolines liv er i fuldstændig frit fald. Hendes døtre driver hende til vanvid, og hendes utaknemmelige chef løber ud af hende, mens hendes mand forlader hende.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: Sounds and Silences
programme.desc: A man's wish to listen to loud noise backfires.

programme.title: Split Second
programme.desc: I en dystopisk fremtid jager en detektiv en seriemorder, der viser sig ikke at være menneskelig.

programme.title: Texas Chainsaw
programme.desc: Gennem mange år var adskillige personer i den lille by Newt i Texas forsvundet sporløst. Befolkningen havde længe mistænkt familien Sawyer, og det lykkedes en ung pige at flygte fra Sawyer-huset efter de brutale drab på hendes fire venner.

programme.title: Dorian Gray
programme.desc: Ben Barnes (kendt fra Narnia - Prince Caspian) spiller den unge og smukke Dorian Gray, som bliver introduceret til Londons dekadente jetset af den charmerende Henry Wotton (Colin Firth - kendt fra Mamma Mia).

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Pas på! Vi er rasende...
programme.desc: Filmen begynder med, at vores venner kører over målstregen samtidigt i et racerløb, hvor præmien er en lækker bil. Nu skal striden så afgøres ved en ædekonkurrence i et tivoli, men pludselig invaderes stedet af gangstere..

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Banana Joe er ellers sådan en fredelig fyr, men nu har han ikke noget andet valg end, på ægte 'Bud Spencer' manér, at smide mafiaen ud af landsbyen Amanlido, så der igen kan blive fredeligt at bo der!

programme.title: Skipper & Co.
programme.desc: Peter drager ud for at udforske verden og møder her Skipper, en plejehjemsbeboer, hvis tilværelse på plejehjemmet er meget trist. De stikker til søs i en jolle. Jollen får motorstop og de driver rundt på havet.

programme.title: Nyt legetøj
programme.desc: En kvinde bliver trukket ind i en alvorlig kriminalitet, da hun møder en gammel elsker, en bilmekaniker, der er bekymret for en iværksætter, der har til hensigt at lukke den butik, hvor han arbejder.

programme.title: Setup
programme.desc: De tre venner Vincent, Sonny og Dave planlægger et stort diamantkup. Men Vincent har brug for alle pengene selv og skyder de to andre. Dog overlever Sonny og vil have hævn.

programme.title: Taken
programme.desc: Den tidligere regeringsagent Bryan Mills står over for sit livs længste 96 timer – jagten på den frygtindgydende organisation, der har taget hans datter.

programme.title: Gasoline Alley
programme.desc: Den rehabiliterede forbryder Jimmy Jayne er den hovedmistænkte i en brutal Hollywood-mordsag og vil gøre alt for at bevise sin uskyld.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: Mens Donna og Vic kæmper for at redde deres vaklende ægteskab, bliver deres søn gode venner med den elskelige, 200 pund tunge 200-lb Skt. Bernhardshund, som tilhører deres mekaniker.

programme.title: Mclintock!
programme.desc: John Wayne spiller hovedrollen som kvægbaronen George Washington McLintock, der kæmper med sin kone, datter og politiske jordbesiddere, kun for i sidste ende at »tæmme« dem alle.

programme.title: Children of the Corn V: Fields of Terror: Children of the Corn V: Fields of Terror

programme.title: Nathan For You: Taxi Service / Hot Dog Stand
programme.desc: Nathan prøver å få pressedekning for et drosjeselskap og han strekker seg langt for å forsvare en pølsebods rykte.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Liquor Store / Examinator / Car Wash
programme.desc: Nathan hjelper et alkoholutsalg å selge til kunder som er for unge, en eksterminator lærer hvordan man jobber diskret.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Dating Website / Party Planner
programme.desc: Nathan hjelper en dateside å tiltrekke kvinnelige brukere; en festplanlegger får nye måter å sende ut invitasjoner på; Nathan deler også sin strategi for selv-motivering.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Dumb Starbucks
programme.desc: Nathan bruker parodi-loven for å hjelpe en kaffesjappe som sliter.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Electronics Store
programme.desc: Nathan slår ned på et stort firma i et forsøk på å hjelpe en elektronikkbutikk som sliter.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Horseback Riding / Man Zone
programme.desc: Nathan finner på en måte en kvegfarm kan inkludere overvektige ryttere på, en eksklusive motebutikk for kvinner prøver å tiltrekke seg mannlige kunder, og Nathan oppdager at han kan ha begått hatkriminalitet.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Sporting Goods Store / Antique Shop
programme.desc: Nathan forsøker å sikre en endosseringsavtale for en sportsbutikk, og en antikkhandel får vite hvordan de bedre skal utnytte 'du betaler for det du knuser'-policyen.

programme.title: Nathan For You: The Movement
programme.desc: Nathan prøver å få arbeidere til å arbeide gratis i et flyttebyrå.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Smokers Allowed
programme.desc: Nathan hjelper en dykkebar å unngå antirøyke-lover.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Travel Agent / Hotel
programme.desc: Et hotell henvender seg til seksuelt aktive foreldre, et reisebyrå profitterer på sine eldre kunder og Nathan deler løsningen for å aldri komme sent.

programme.title: God Bless America
programme.desc: Arbeidsløs, nyskilt og dødssyk, har Frank fått nok av den nedadgående spiralen Amerika har påført seg selv. Med, i hans øyne, alt å vinne, tar Frank med børsa og plaffer ned de dummeste, grusomste og mest frastøtende medlemmene av samfunnet.

programme.title: Centurion
programme.desc: Når Romerrikets legendariske Niende Legion blir offer for et bakholdsangrep av stammefolket Picter, langt nord i Storbritannia, må soldaten Quintus (Michael Fassbender) og det som er igjen av legionen kjempe en desperat kamp bak fiendens linjer.

programme.title: The Homesman
programme.desc: Mary Bee Cuddy 'Hilary Swank' er en singel og 'voksen' dame i en liten ørkenby i Nebraska på 1800'tallet. Til tross for at hun har en betydlig sum med penger og masse land blir hun gang på gang avvist av potensielle ektemenn.

programme.title: Seraphim Falls
programme.desc: En ensom, nedslitt mann sitter ved et bål i en lysning, da stillheten med ett rives i stykker av et skudd. Mannen treffes i skulderen. Oberst Carver jakter på mannen. Dette er begynnelsen på en jakt som vil føre de to mennene rundt i Amerika.

programme.title: Till Death
programme.desc: Etter en romantisk kveld i deres avsidesliggende hus, våkner Emma opp lenket til sin døde ektemann. Hun er fanget og isolert og må kjempe mot leiemordere for å unnslippe ektemannens avsindige plan.

programme.title: Official Secrets
programme.desc: Den sanne historien om en britisk varsler som lekket informasjon til media om en ulovlig NSA-operasjon, hvis formål var å presse FNs sikkerhetsråd til å godkjenne invasjonen av Irak i 2003.

programme.title: What If
programme.desc: Den håpløst romantiske Wallace har droppet ut av medisinstudiet og har brent seg på kjærligheten. Når han møter Chantry, som dessverre er i et forpliktende forhold til kjæresten Ben, oppstår en umiddelbar gnist mellom dem.

programme.title: Benjamin
programme.desc: I Simon Amstells rørende, bittersøte komedie, blir en ung, fremadstormende filmskaper kastet inn i en emosjonell malstrøm av en spirende romanse og den kommende premieren på hans andre spillefilm.

programme.title: The Twilight Zone: The Mirror
programme.desc: After a poor but ambitious Central American farm worker overthrows his country's tyrannical leader, he believes he sees assassins everywhere. A look in the mirror reveals his most dangerous enemy.

programme.title: We Need to Do Something
programme.desc: Melissa og familien hennes låser seg inne på badet under en storm, når et tre faller gjennom huset og blokkerer døren. Fanget uten mulighet for kontakt med omverdenen begynner det provisoriske ly å ligne mer og mer på en dødsfelle...

programme.title: Ginger Snaps
programme.desc: En tenåringsjente forsøker å hindre søsteren sin fra å bli til en varulv.

programme.title: Black Moon Rising
programme.desc: Fest sikkerhetsbeltet for en fantastisk tur i Black Moon, en høyteknologisk, aerodynamisk superbil som kan nå en topphastighet på 560 km/t. Det er i dette fartsvidunderet at CIAs mestertyv Sam Quint tilfeldigvis skjuler en hemmelig datadisk

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: På Westerburg High, hvor klikker hersker, jocks dominerer og alle de populære jentene heter Heather, vil det kreve en Veronica og et mystisk nytt barn for å gi tenåringsangst en kroppstelling.

programme.title: In Harm's Way
programme.desc: Producer-director Otto Preminger’s epic treatment of the bombing of Pearl Harbor details the devastating attack on the Hawaiian naval base as well as the explosive, behind-the-scenes stories.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: Hondo er en kavalerist som blir Angie sin beskytter og en farsfigur til hennes sønn. Angie venter bestemt på at mannen hennes skal komme hjem og nekter å forlate gården deres til tross for den økende faren. Filmen vises uten norske undertekster.

programme.title: Vi holder med flodhestene
programme.desc: En av Terence Hill og Bud Spencers aller største suksesser – og det sier ikke lite.

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead
programme.desc: En broket gjeng med innbyggere i Pennsylvania barrikaderer seg i et gammelt gårdshus for å holde seg trygge fra en horde kjøttetende monstre som herjer i det nordøstlige USA.

programme.title: April Fool'S Day
programme.desc: Da Muffy St. John (Deborah Foreman, VALLEY GIRL) inviterte sine college-venner til sine foreldres hjem på en isolert øy for et høydepunkt i livet, glemte hun å fortelle at det mye mulig kunne bli det siste høydepunktet i deres liv.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 503
programme.desc: Tina og Danni solgte rekkehuset sitt i den tro at de snart skulle finne det rette huset. Men sånn gikk det ikke. Paret er utrolig kresne, og har høye krav. Kan ekspertene skape hjemmet som Tina og Danni drømmer om?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 504
programme.desc: Laura og Jesper og Jespers to barn leier i Humlebæk, og de er mildt sagt lei av det. De mangler plass, hage - og de vil også ha barn sammen snart. Men to års husjakt har ikke gitt resultat.

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 505
programme.desc: Ulla og Kristian bor i en vakker herskapsleilighet på Frederiksberg med sine to barn. Men de vil ha mer plass i et barnevennlig nabolag, innom sykkelavstand fra sentrum. Kan Tobias Edlev-Nielsen finne et hus til dem?

programme.title: Boligkjøp i blinde Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: En liten leiebolig i Vanløse og to små barn - ikke den beste kombinasjonen. Lisa og Erling drømmer om et stort hus med en stor hage. Tobias må jobbe hardt, da drømmene er mye større enn budsjettet.

programme.title: Mutant X: Presumed Guilty
programme.desc: Adam er innrammet for drap av en ny mutant med evnen til å stjele folks minner.

programme.title: Mutant X: Nothing to Fear
programme.desc: En mutant med telepatiske evner som kan få folk til å oppleve, mentalt, alt han vil, klarer å komme inn i hodet på Mutant X. Nå får han dem til å oppleve sin verste frykt.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dancing on the Razor
programme.desc: Når Mutant X og Genomex blir fanget på film ved hjelp av kreftene sine, må de begge forholde seg til reporteren som planlegger å bli offentlig med informasjonen.

programme.title: Mutant X: Ex Marks the Spot
programme.desc: Shalimars tidligere kjæreste dukker opp og prøver å gjenopprette et Fabergé-egg som har en mikrochip med ekstraordinær kraft.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Love Letter
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel drar til Frankrike for å lete etter de tapte bryllupsløftene til Josephine Pontoise og Guy de Bourdin, noe som skulle bevise at arvingen er den rettmessige eieren av St. Agnes Sur-Loire.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Tid for å levere
programme.desc: Etter at Walker ikke klarer å stoppe en ung gutt fra å begå selvmord på skolen, må han komme over tristheten og sinnet ved å motivere skolen til å bli bedre.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Helt frisk igjen
programme.desc: Walker og rangerne avdekker en plan om å begå et dødelig saringassangrep mot landet.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Et spørsmål om tro
programme.desc: I denne juleepisoden må Walker og teamet finne gjerningspersonene som stjal gaver til vanskeligstilte barn fra en lokal kirke og etterlot pastoren i koma.

programme.title: Walker Texas Ranger: Åndelig reise

programme.desc: Eighteen-year-old Romain has just graduated and makes a stop at his dealer's place to try a new pill. programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: The Hallow
programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

programme.title: Mon Mon Mon Monsters
programme.desc: While assigned to community duty, teenagers stumble upon a flesh-eating female ghoul and decide to capture her.

programme.title: Last Ones Out
programme.desc: A skeptical American is stranded in the middle of a zombie-infected Africa and must rely on the help of three mysterious strangers to make it out alive.

programme.title: Alone
programme.desc: Teenage delinquents who are living in an island youth center wake up to find themselves alone with no one to watch over them. After much partying, they realize the island has been deserted and the adults have been infected by a mysterious epidemic.

programme.title: Dead Shack
programme.desc: On a weekend getaway at a rundown cottage in the woods, a 14-year-old teen, his best friend, and his best friend's older sister must work together to save their hard-partying parents from their predatory person in the cabin next to them.

programme.title: Mandrake
programme.desc: Probation officer Cathy Madden is given the task of rehabilitating notorious killer "Bloody" Mary Laidlaw back into society after 20 years in jail. Cathy's beliefs are firmly tested when two children disappear near Mary's farm.

programme.title: Infested
programme.desc: Passionate about exotic animals, Kaleb brings a venomous spider home, but it accidentally slips away. Soon, residents of the apartment building are battling an army of deadly, rapidly reproducing spiders.

programme.title: Blood Quantum
programme.desc: The dead are coming back to life and almost all of Earth's population is decimated due to a zombie virus, except for the isolated Mi'kmaq reserve of Red Crow, whose indigenous inhabitants are strangely immune to the zombie plague.

programme.title: Virus-32
programme.desc: A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

programme.title: Almost Human
programme.desc: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

programme.title: The Sadness
programme.desc: As Taiwan succumbs to a viral pandemic that transforms peaceful citizens into sadistic, bloodthirsty maniacs, a young couple must battle to be reunited before they too become infected.

programme.title: Devil's Pass
programme.desc: To determine what happened to some Russian hikers, five U.S. college students go back to where the hikers were found dead. The students don't return from the expedition, either, and the recovered footage is deemed too disturbing for public viewing.

programme.title: Contracted
programme.desc: A young woman (Najarra Townsend) begins bleeding, shedding maggots and hallucinating after a stranger date rapes her at a party.

programme.title: Allegoria
programme.desc: A timid actress, a tortured painter, a pretentious writer, a psychotic sculptor and a rock band all become entangled when their insecurities manifest themselves into monsters and ghouls.

programme.title: Blood Flower
programme.desc: A young apprentice healer tries to suppress his supernatural abilities so he can fit in with the other kids, but when a malicious spirit breaks out in his apartment he decides to use his abilities while dark family secrets are revealed.

programme.title: Revealer
programme.desc: A stripper and a religious protester are trapped together in a peep show booth and must come together to survive the apocalypse.

programme.title: Scare Package
programme.desc: Seven filmmakers present seven terrifying and comedic tales of horror.

programme.title: PG: Psycho Goreman
programme.desc: Intergalactic assassins converge on a small town after two siblings unwittingly resurrect an ancient alien overlord.

programme.title: All the Creatures Were Stirring
programme.desc: The joyful spirit of Christmas takes one dark turn after another -- from sadistic office parties and last-minute shopping nightmares to vengeful stalkers and immortal demons.

programme.title: Glorious
programme.desc: A heartbroken man finds himself trapped in a bathroom with a strange voice who says he may be the only hope in stopping a terrible event.

programme.title: Skull: The Mask
programme.desc: A supernatural serial killer based on pre-Colombian mythology hunts for revenge in the metropolis of São Paulo.

programme.title: MadS

programme.title: Blood Glacier
programme.desc: Scientists discover that a red liquid leaking from a nearby glacier contains organisms that turn living hosts into deadly mutants.

programme.title: The Hallow
programme.desc: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

programme.title: Superdeep
programme.desc: In 1984 a Russian research team goes below the surface to find out what secret the world's deepest borehole is hiding. On their expedition, something unexpectedly gruesome awaits the researchers.

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre 2
programme.desc: Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) seeks to avenge the murder of his kin by Leatherface, Chop-Top, The Cook and Grandpa. With the help of a radio DJ he finds his way to their underground slaughter shop, where a battle of epic proportions will soon rage.

programme.title: Vicious Lips
programme.desc: The Vicious Lips get a shot to make it as the galaxy's next big musical act, but their hopes soon come crashing back to earth. Hastily signing up the wide-eyed Judy Jetson to front the band, the Lips blast off on their meteoric rise to superstardom.

programme.title: Night Of The Comet
programme.desc: In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

programme.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
programme.desc: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

programme.title: Count Yorga, Vampire
programme.desc: Two young lovers are stranded overnight in a van, unaware they're outside the mansion of a revenous vampire who is feeding on any trespassers!

programme.title: The Return Of Count Yorga
programme.desc: It's a love story with bite when a revived Count Yorga roams the city in search of new blood...until he finds a girl to share eternity with!

programme.title: Burnt Offerings
programme.desc: Karen Black, Oliver Reed and Bette Davis star in this chiller as a family is surrounded by an evil presence that feeds on torture, fear and murder.

programme.title: The Initiation Of Sarah
programme.desc: In this cult-classic thriller, Kay Lenz and Shelley Winters star as a co-ed and the witchy head of a sorority who has special plans for the new girl.

programme.title: Audrey Rose
programme.desc: Suppose a stranger told you that your daughter was his child reincarnated. Anthony Hopkins and Marsha Mason star in this hair-raising occult thriller.

programme.title: Invasion Of The Body Snatchers
programme.desc: Under cover of darkness, while an unsuspecting city sleeps, an alien life form begins to sow the seeds of unspeakable terror. Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Leonard Nimoy, Veronica Cartwright & Jeff Goldblum star in this classic suspense thriller.

programme.title: Species
programme.desc: When a beautiful alien hybrid (Natasha Henstridge) escapes from his lab, a scientist (Ben Kingsley) hires a team of experts to find her before she is able to mate and produce offspring. It's a desperate battle and the fate of humanity is at stake!

programme.title: Species II
programme.desc: When an astronaut morphs into an alien entity, impregnating women with deadly results, a clone of Eve (Natasha Henstridge) is sent to hunt him down. But they underestimate Eve's maternal drive...and now only the strongest species will survive!

programme.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
programme.desc: Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

programme.title: The Dark Half
programme.desc: When a horror novelist tries to "kill off" his successful author pseudonym, he finds his alter ego on a greusome quest for revenge.

programme.title: Strange Invaders
programme.desc: Unaware the entire citizenry has been replaced by aliens, a professor arrives in a Midwestern town looking for his ex-wife who vanished.

programme.title: It! The Terror From Beyond Space
programme.desc: Panic is rampant in this acclaimed thriller about a band of space explorers who suddenly find themselves being hunted by a maniacal creature.

programme.title: Donovan's Brain
programme.desc: Scientist Patrick Corey has a hideous hobby - he keeps brains alive! But when the brain of dead murderer W.H. Donovan falls into his possession, he finds that it has a mind of its ownand is controlling him through telepathic messages!

programme.title: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: To restore the life of his fiancee, who was decapitated in an automobile accident, a brilliant surgeon tries to find a suitable body to attach to her head, which he keeps alive and locked in a dungeon. But nothing will stop her from getting revenge!

programme.title: Blood And Chocolate
programme.desc: A young teenage werewolf (Bruckner) is torn between honoring her family's secret and her love for a man (Dancy).

programme.title: Mom
programme.desc: Most moms are wonderful cooks, this one...likes it raw! Something's been eating Clay Dwyer. His mom! Once a sweet lovable lady, she's been bitten by and transformed into a flesheater, turning her into a hungry creature with a knack for good old homestyle cooking. What is Clay to do? To everyone else she's a monster that must be destroyed. But to him she's still MOM.

programme.title: Leviathan
programme.desc: In this sci-fi thriller, Peter Weller leads an exploration team trapped five miles beneath the ocean's surface with a creature that cannot die!

programme.title: Die, Monster, Die!
programme.desc: An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

programme.title: The Dunwich Horror
programme.desc: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

programme.title: The Curse
programme.desc: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change...hideously!

programme.title: From Beyond
programme.desc: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

programme.title: Child's Play (1988)
programme.desc: Only young Andy realizes that his doll, Chucky, is inhabited by the soul of a killer and is responsible for a spate of gruesome murders. But the real terror begins when Chucky becomes determined to transfer his evil spirit to a human being... Andy!

programme.title: The Burning
programme.desc: Gather around the campfire....to die! After a cruel joke severely disfigures him, camp caretaker Cropsy is back -- with hedge clippers in hand -- seeking revenge on those who scarred him! Can the campers save themselves before he kills them all?

programme.title: Judgment of Amber Guyger
programme.desc: Off-duty Dallas police officer Amber Guyger found Botham Jean in her apartment; the only thing more shocking than the revelations of Botham Jean's murder was the act of forgiveness at the end of the trial.

programme.title: Judgment of the Murder-for-Hire Masquerade
programme.desc: Tommy Carlton owed his ex-wife Elizabeth $85,000 in back child support; so he allegedly paid a hit man $2,000 to make her go away permanently; the hit man was an undercover cop and Elizabeth helped stage her demise.

programme.title: Judgment of Aileen Wuornos
programme.desc: Aileen Wuornos sold her body to survive; this generated a deep-seated rage for those who would pay for her services which allegedly resulted in the deaths of seven Florida men.

programme.title: SC v. Robertson

programme.desc: Mattie is assigned the unglamorous job of searching for a lost dog, but the case is put on hold when one of a band's members turns up murdered.

programme.title: Death by Vinyl, Final Chapter
programme.desc: Mattie investigates a new victim: the band's manager, who was stabbed in the back with a kitchen knife.

programme.title: Between The Lines
programme.desc: While traveling through India, Xena and Gabrielle's souls are sent into the future through the power of Mehndi to protect their good Karma from the reincarnated Alti (Claire Stansfield).

programme.title: The Way
programme.desc: Xena invokes the help of the god Krishna (Rajiv Varma) to rescue Gabrielle and Eli (Timothy Omundson) from Indrajit (Rajneel Singh), the King of Demons.

programme.title: The Play's The Thing
programme.desc: Gabrielle unwittingly becomes a pawn in a theater scam when one of her scrolls falls into the hands of Zehra, the "Queen of Cons."

programme.title: The Convert
programme.desc: Najara returns claiming she has renounced violence, while Joxer deals with his first kill.

programme.title: Takes One to Know One
programme.desc: On a dark and stormy night, Xena must determine which one of her friends is a murderer.

programme.title: Endgame
programme.desc: When Brutus kills Ephiny, Gabrielle is called back to be queen of the Amazons.

programme.title: The Ides Of March
programme.desc: Callisto returns to tempt Xena as Caesar plans to declare himself emperor.

programme.title: Deja Vu All Over Again
programme.desc: A woman is convinced she is the reincarnation of Xena, the Warrior Princess.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: After being crucified by the Romans, Gabrielle's (Renee O'Connor) soul struggles to save Xena (Lucy Lawless), who literally becomes a demon from Hell.

programme.title: Chakram
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has no recollection of being a warrior after she and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) are resurrected from the dead by Eli (Tim Omundson).

programme.title: Succession
programme.desc: Ares (Kevin Smith) merges Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) into the same body and forces them to fight Mavican (Jenya Lano), Ares' potential right hand.

programme.title: Animal Attraction
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless), Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Amarice (Jennifer Sky) travel to the town of Spamona, where Xena is shocked to learn that she is pregnant.

programme.title: Them Bones, Them Bones
programme.desc: The spirit of the evil Shamaness Alti (Claire Stansfield) attempts to capture the soul of Xena's (Lucy Lawless) unborn child.

programme.title: Purity
programme.desc: When Xena (Lucy Lawless) returns to Chin to recover Lao Ma's book of power, she must defeat one of Lao Ma's twin daughters, who wants to acquire the power for her own evil purposes.

programme.title: Back in the Bottle
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) must master Lao Ma's powers to save Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), Joxer (Ted Raimi), and the people of Chin from a militia led by the evil spirits of Pao Ssu (Marie Matiko) and her brother, Ming Tien (Daniel Sing).

programme.title: Little Problems
programme.desc: Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) and Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) have until sundown to save Xena's (Lucy Lawless) soul from being trapped inside a young girl forever.

programme.title: Seeds of Faith
programme.desc: Eli (Timothy Omundson) tries to overthrow the gods by battling Ares (Kevin Smith); Xena (Lucy Lawless) learns the identity of her baby's father.

programme.title: Lyre, Lyre, Hearts On Fire
programme.desc: A musical episode in which Xena (Lucy Lawless) is reunited with her mother, Cyrene (Darien Takle), Joxer (Ted Raimi) is reunited with his twin and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) meets Draco (Jay Laga'aia).

programme.title: Punch Lines
programme.desc: Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) and Argo are shrunken into miniature versions of themselves when they cross paths with Lachrymose (Jon Gadsby), the god of despair.

programme.title: God Fearing Child
programme.desc: Elliott and Maya (Enrico Colantoni, Laura San Giacomo) decide to keep their newfound relationship a secret. With George Segal.

programme.title: Eternal Bonds
programme.desc: While Xena (Lucy Lawless) fights off priests' armies, Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) seeks an antidote for Joxer's (Ted Raimi) poisonous wound.

programme.title: Amphipolis Under Siege
programme.desc: Xena's (Lucy Lawless) hometown, Amphipolis, is attacked by Athena's (Paris Jefferson) warriors in an attempt to get Xena's child.

programme.title: Married With Fishsticks
programme.desc: A merman (Ted Raimi) convinces an injured Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) that she is his wife and the mother of his children.

programme.title: Lifeblood
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle (Lucy Lawless, Renee O'Connor) must prevent an Amazon war against the Samite nomads.

programme.title: Kindred Spirits
programme.desc: Joxer (Ted Raimi) breaks Amazon laws that force Queen Gabrielle (Renée O'Connor) to choose between settling down in the Amazon village and life on the road with Xena (Lucy Lawless).

programme.title: Antony & Cleopatra
programme.desc: When Cleopatra (Josephine Davison) is murdered, Xena (Lucy Lawless) assumes her identity to uncover the assassin and protect Egypt.

programme.title: Looking Death in the Eye
programme.desc: Joxer (Ted Raimi), now in his 60s, finds the last scroll written by Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), recounting their battle to protect Xena's (Lucy Lawless) child.

programme.title: Livia
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle (Lucy Lawless, Renee O'Connor) are freed from their icy prison after 25 years and set out to find Eve (Adrienne Wilkinson), who has become a fearless commander in Rome.

programme.title: Eve
programme.desc: Eve (Adrienne Wilkinson) continues her quest to kill all of Eli's cult followers, and Xena (Lucy Lawless) must decide how to stop her.

programme.title: Motherhood
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) battles the gods with her newfound power as Eve (Adrienne Wilkinson) atones for her past sins.

programme.title: Coming Home
programme.desc: Ares (Kevin Smith) needs Xena's (Lucy Lawless) help to restore his godly powers, but he gets more than he bargained for when the Furies play a trick on him. With Renee O'Connor and Sela Apera.

programme.title: Haunting of Amphipolis
programme.desc: On her trip home, Xena (Lucy Lawless) finds the town possessed and sinister powers awaiting her. With Renee O'Connor, Charles Mesure and Adrienne Wilkinson.

programme.title: Heart of Darkness
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) must devise a plan to avoid inheriting the kingdom of hell. With Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: Who's Gurkham?
programme.desc: Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) sets out on a rescue mission to North Africa with the gang in tow when she discovers her niece has been kidnapped. With Lucy Lawless, Adrienne Wilkinson, William Gregory Lee and Calvin Tuteao.

programme.title: Legacy
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle (Lucy Lawless, Renee O'Connor) try to help two warring African tribes unite against their Roman enemies.

programme.title: The Abyss
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle (Lucy Lawless, Renee O'Connor) are confronted by cannibals as they search for Virgil (William Gregory Lee).

programme.title: The Rheingold
programme.desc: Beowulf (guest star Renato Bartolomei), a Norse warrior, sets out on a quest with Xena (Lucy Lawless) after she decides to right a wrong from her dark past.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) must battle Grindl, a monster she created when she was an evil warrior, in order to recover a dangerous enchanted ring. With Renee O'Connor, Glen Levy, Luanne Gordon, Brittney Powell and Renato Bartolomei.

programme.title: Return of the Valkyrie
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has amnesia as Hrothgar's (guest star John Leigh) bride, Wealthea, and must regain her memory in order to save Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor).

programme.title: Old Ares Had A Farm
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) disguises Ares (Kevin Smith) as a farmer to hide him from warlords seeking revenge.

programme.title: Dangerous Prey
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) becomes the ultimate prey for a deranged Amazon hunter, Prince Morloch (guest star Sandy Winton).

programme.title: The God You Know
programme.desc: Michael the archangel (guest star Charles Mesure) orders Xena (Lucy Lawless) to hunt down the Roman emperor Caligula (guest star Alexis Arquette), who has become immortal, and kill him.

programme.title: You Are There
programme.desc: A tabloid reporter (guest star Michael Hurst) tries to get the scoop on Xena (Lucy Lawless) and her motivation for her quest to obtain the legendary golden apples from Valhalla. With Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: Path of Vengeance
programme.desc: Eve (Adrienne Wilkinson) faces execution when she returns to Amazon lands to make amends for the past. With Lucy Lawless and Renee O'Connor.

programme.title: To Helicon And Back
programme.desc: Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) leads the Amazons to Helicon to rescue kidnapped Queen Varia (guest star Tsianina Joelson). With Lucy Lawless.

programme.title: Send in the Clones
programme.desc: Three modern-day fans of Xena create clones of Xena and Gabrielle (Lucy Lawless, Renee O'Connor).

programme.title: Last of the Centaurs
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) must save a young centaur from the clutches of Lord Belach (Marton Csokas).

programme.title: When Fates Collide
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) becomes the Empress of Rome with no memory of her past when Caesar (Karl Urban) chains up the three Fates and cuts the strands of time to alter his destiny.

programme.title: Many Happy Returns
programme.desc: On their way to deliver the Helmet of Hermes to Thebes, Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) save the young virgin Genia (Katie Stuart) from being sacrificed by religious zealots.

programme.title: Soul Possession
programme.desc: When an ancient scroll chronicling the life of Xena surfaces in the present, conflicts arise among the modern-day reincarnations of Xena (Lucy Lawless), Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor), Ares (Kevin Smith) and Joxer (Ted Raimi).

programme.title: Friend in Need, Part 1
programme.desc: Summoned by a long-lost spiritual soulmate, Xena (Lucy Lawless) heads for Japan with Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) on a daunting mission to save the city of Higuchi from destruction and make amends for her past.

programme.title: Friend in Need, Part 2
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) and Gabrielle (Renee O'Connor) face the greatest threat they've ever known when they go up against the evil Yodoshi (Adrian Brown) and an army of 20,000 elite Samurai warriors.

programme.title: Sins of the Past
programme.desc: Xena atones for her evil past by defending her home village from the marauding warlord Draco.

programme.title: Voice Of Reason
programme.desc: Randall Strong (Gordon Clapp) is on a mission to convince the US Military that aliens are threatening Earth, but committee Chairman Thornwell (Daniel J. Travanti) seems to be Strong's biggest stumbling block. Could Thornewll be one of... "them"?

programme.title: A Stitch In Time
programme.desc: FBI agent Jamie Pratt (Michelle Forbes) investigates a perplexing case when her best friend becomes a killer's next victim. The mystery takes her through five decades of time, where reality changes at each and every turn...in the Outer Limits.

programme.title: Resurrection
programme.desc: Life on Earth has been wiped out by biological warfare, with androids the only survivors. Two such androids (Heather Graham, Dana Ashbrook) recreate a human from DNA and must protect him from a military force which wants humankind annihilated.

programme.title: Unnatural Selection
programme.desc: Howard (Alan Ruck) and Joanne (Catherine Mary Stewart) are happily expecting their first child. They live in a world where genetic alteration is rampantly purchased on the black market...but nothing comes without a price in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: I Hear You Calling
programme.desc: After intercepting a strange phone call, a tenacious reporter (Ally Sheedy) finds herself in a deadly game of cat and mouse. The only clues to the mystery: a strange man with violet eyes and missing persons who leave behind a pile of purple ash.

programme.title: Mind Over Matter
programme.desc: When an accident puts Dr. Stein's (Mark Hamill) colleague, Rachel, in a coma, he uses his newly-created invention to reach her brain and tell her he loves her. However, Stein discovers that love takes strange turns when it enters the virtual world.

programme.title: Beyond The Veil
programme.desc: After flashbacks of an alien abduction lead him to attempt suicide, Eddie Wexler (Michael O'Keefe) is institutionalized, with a doctor who seems intent on forcing him to relive his "memories." Is Eddie insane? Or is the doctor more than he seems?

programme.title: First Anniversary
programme.desc: As he celebrates his first anniversary, Norman (Matt Frewer) thinks he's the luckiest man alive. But suddenly, his lovely wife doesn't seem the same and he can't stand to be around her. Is he going crazy or are his instincts telling him something?

programme.title: Straight And Narrow
programme.desc: Problem child Rusty (Ryan Phillippe) finds himself thrown into a private school bent on straightening him out with some unorthodox methods. Rusty has eluded their control so far, but can he escape from this prison of the mind?

programme.title: Trial By Fire
programme.desc: On the first day of his presidency, Charles Halsey (Robert Foxworth) is faced with the first galactic foreign policy decision. As aliens are approaching Earth, the peace-loving president must determine if they are invaders or benevolent explorers.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: In a bizarre twist of fate, Nancy McDonald (Bonnie Bedelia) receives a distress call from Lindy (Chad Willett), a former lover, who was lost in space twenty years earlier. And he has a message: He's alive...and he desperately needs her help.

programme.title: The Refuge
programme.desc: A man (James Wilder) finds himself in what seems to be a refuge in a post-apocalyptic world, lorded over by a sadistic industrialist (M. Emmet Walsh) who pits his guests against one another for enjoyment...but all is not what it seems to be.

programme.title: Inconstant Moon
programme.desc: When a lonely physics professor Stanley Hurst (Michael Gross) realizes the sun is going to burn out, he knows that he and humanity have only a few hours to live. In that time, Stan resolves to make up for lost years.

programme.title: From Within
programme.desc: Howie (Neil Patrick Harris), a boy with intellectual disabilities, is the last unaffected person in a town overrun by a strange, parasitic madness. On his own for the first time, Howie has only himself to rely upon if he wants to save his sister!

programme.title: The Heist
programme.desc: After a friend's betrayal cost him his Army career, Lee Taylor (Costas Mandylor) helps a self-styled militia Major hijack an Army shipment. Expecting missiles, they find a mysterious cargo and a lone Army Guard who warns of its deadly capability.

programme.title: Afterlife
programme.desc: Convicted of a murder he didn't commit, Linden Stiles can either accept execution or become the subject of a military experiment. Choosing to live, he finds himself slowly dehumanized by the alien DNA that has been injected into him.

programme.title: The Deprogrammers
programme.desc: With Earth under alien rule, humanity has been programmed into slavery. A band of rebels kidnap Evan (Erich Anderson), one of the alien leader's slaves. After a twist of fate, Evan agrees to assassinate his former master...with devastating results.

programme.title: Paradise
programme.desc: When three young women age and die within hours, a small town is turned upside down. How does Helen (Maxine Miller), a doctor's aging mother, play into these deaths? The answer to the puzzling mystery of fragile youth is soon to be revealed.

programme.title: The Light Brigade
programme.desc: On a desperate mission to survive, a young military cadet (Will Wheaton) learns the difference between heroic ideals and the bitter realities of war as he and his dying comrades prepare a strike against the aliens who may have condemn them to death.

programme.title: Out Of Body
programme.desc: What really happens during an out-of-body experience? Scientist Rebecca (Peri Gilpin) is so desperate to find out that she decides run an experiment on herself. But not everyone is happy of the lengths science will go to for empirical proof.

programme.title: The Sentence
programme.desc: Inventor Dr. Jack Henson (David Hyde Pierce) comes up with a "virtual prison" where criminals serve a life sentence in just a few, cost-efficient hours. When an innocent man's life is at stake, the doctor must submit himself to his own invention.

programme.title: Bits Of Love
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic underground bunker, a virtual reality world begins to turn on its inventor (Jon Tenney) after he becomes romantically involved with -- and then spurns -- the holographic interface (Natasha Henstridge) that controls the system.

programme.title: Second Thoughts
programme.desc: A mentally challenged man (Howie Mandel) is made more intelligent by a machine that transfers people's memories and experiences into his head, but kills its victims. And he soon discovers that the mind can be a minefield in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Re-Generation
programme.desc: After a couple's son dies, an experimental procedure harvests the boy's nerve cells, allowing the mother to give birth to a genetically identical child. But soon it becomes clear that this fetus is not just identical...it is actually Justin himself.

programme.title: Last Supper
programme.desc: A man's family is turned upside down when he discovers that his son's college sweetheart is the same woman he rescued from a secret military experiment twenty years before...only she has not aged a day since. Peter Onorati and Fred Savage star.

programme.title: Stream Of Consciousness
programme.desc: When "the Stream" -- an artificial system providing information to all society members through computer chips implanted in their brains -- begins to malfunction, an unlikely, "primitive" man (George Newbern) may be the mankind's only hope.

programme.title: Dark Rain
programme.desc: After a chemical war renders the world's population unable to conceive healthy children, a mother and father must escape from a sinister government agency intent on using their miraculously healthy newborn to repopulate the species.

programme.title: The Camp
programme.desc: In a society imprisoned for generations by extraterrestrial who invaded Earth, an electronics expert (Harley Jane Kozak) discovers that not only are her human jailers really machines, but they also have been holding prisoners for nearly a century.

programme.title: Heart's Desire
programme.desc: A preacher descends upon the 18th century town of Heart's Desire and offers to share his extraordinary powers with four outlaws. But who is this stranger and why has he given these outlaws such deadly powers? Caspar Van Dien and Esai Morales star.

programme.title: Tempests
programme.desc: Attempting to deliver serum to a plague-stricken planet, a pilot (Eric McCormack) and his crew crash land on an unknown moon. Bitten by an alien spider while fixing the ship, the pilot's mind wanders between alternate realities...in The Outer Limits.

programme.title: The Awakening
programme.desc: A woman unable to feel emotions gets a new lease on life when a brain implant allows her to experience feelings for the first time. But, when the implant malfunctions, driving her towards insanity, she is shocked at the real cause of her problems.

programme.title: New Lease
programme.desc: A remorseless, uncaring scientist (Stephen Lang) and his partner (Michael Ontkean) discover a way to bring life back to the recently deceased. But after the scientist is killed and brought back to life himself, will he choose to live differently?

programme.title: Double Helix
programme.desc: Brilliant geneticist Martin Nodel (Ron Rifkin) unlocks a secret code imprinted on human DNA. But when he tests this code on himself, his "instincts" draw him to a remote location where he finds a trip...to The Outer Limits. Ryan Reynolds co-stars.

programme.title: Dead Man's Switch
programme.desc: When it is not known if aliens headed to Earth are friend or foe, five people are placed in secret bunkers to man switches that, if not pressed at specified intervals, will set off mass destruction that will destroy everything, alien or human alike.

programme.title: Hearts And Minds
programme.desc: Engaged as soldiers on a distant planet to prevent a race of alien bugs from stealing minerals that provide the Earth's energy, a woman (Christine Elise) and her troops accidentally discover that the real enemy may not be the aliens at all.

programme.title: Music Of The Spheres
programme.desc: When a seemingly harmless audio signal from space causes physiological changes in Earth's youth, a young scientist races against time to discover what exactly is happening and why. Could the changes be necessary for the survival of the planet?

programme.title: In Another Life
programme.desc: A despondent man finds himself torn between killing himself and killing his co-workers. Before he can do either, he's pulled into The Outer Limits where there are hundreds of versions of him, each with a different life and a different character.

programme.title: The Revelations Of 'Becka Paulson
programme.desc: A woman's life changes dramatically when she accidentally shoots herself in the head which causes her to not only grow more intelligent, but also to realize how dull her life was before the photo in a picture frame started talking to her.

programme.title: Bodies Of Evidence
programme.desc: When an incident at a space station leaves three people dead, the captain of the ship returns to Earth to face murder charges. Is the captain a murderous madman? Or has he actually seen the face of evil floating in the zero-gravity of deep space?

programme.title: Feasibility Study
programme.desc: The residents of a suburban neighborhood have their lives turned upside down when a four block section of their subdivision is ripped from the earth by a mysterious force and transported to a distant planet. David McCallum and Laura Harris star.

programme.title: A Special Edition
programme.desc: Muckraking TV journalist Donald Rivers (Alan Thicke), host of "The Whole Truth," has the show of a lifetime: rock solid-proof that the government and private defense contractors have been engaging in secret genetic cloning.

programme.title: In The Zone
programme.desc: Using an experimental treatment, a scientist (Pat Morita) helps an aging athlete (Adrian Pasdar) end his career on a high note by accelerating his reflexes for one last match. But with victory comes side-effects...courtesy of The Outer Limits.

programme.title: Rite Of Passage
programme.desc: In a society controlled by aliens, a mother rebels when she is forced to give up her child to Mother, a wise alien who acts as a parent to all infants. Determined to get the child back, she embarks upon a dangerous quest that will change her world.

programme.title: Criminal Nature
programme.desc: When Genetic Engineering creates super-babies, some suffer from Genetic Rejection Syndrome (GRS), making them stronger and more deadly. A detective (Gary Cole) must stop his GRS son, a suspected killer, but must take a serum to become more like him.

programme.title: The Hunt
programme.desc: Hunters pay to hunt androids that have a chip that keeps them from harming humans. However, secretly planted data allows the androids to disable the chip, and the balance of power shifts between men and machines! Starring Ron White and Doug Savant.

programme.title: Relativity Theory
programme.desc: Xenobiologist Teresa Janovitch (Melissa Gilbert) is on a military team searching an uninhabited planet for minerals. When the team is attacked by aliens and a retaliation is successful, Janovitch makes a shocking discovery about the victims.

programme.title: Josh
programme.desc: Reporter Judy Warren (Kate Vernon) tracks down Josh (Alex McArthur), a recluse who performs miracles. Alien or angel? All that Judy knows is that now the military is involved and she doesn't trust them. If she can help Josh, will she find the truth?

programme.title: Glyphic
programme.desc: A medical specialist (Peter Flemming) examines a case involving an epidemic that killed a number of children in a small town. Through hypnosis, he probes the mind of a surviving child (Rachel Leigh Cook) and unravels a memory of "alien" proportions.

programme.title: Identity Crisis
programme.desc: As part of a top-secret program, the brain content of a military Captain (Lou Diamond Phillips) is temporarily transferred to an android to create a superior soldier. But, when things go wrong, can the transfer be reversed? Also starring Robert Joy.

programme.title: The Vaccine
programme.desc: A group of hospital patients and their nurse, Marie Alexander (Maria Conchita Alonso), survive a global, terrorist bio-attack. A vaccine arrives, but there are only three doses. Who will be chosen? Will it be survival of the fittest?

programme.title: Fear Itself
programme.desc: Bernard (Ayre Gross) is haunted by images from his past and the tragic death of his sister...a death he caused. An experimental treatment brings positive results, but also a dangerous side effect: Bernard can now transfer his fear to others!

programme.title: The Joining
programme.desc: When a transport ship Captain (C. Thomas Howell) is rescued after surviving a devastating crash on Venus, strange things begin to happen when he returns to Earth. He did what it took to survive on Venus, but could the price of survival be too high?

programme.title: To Tell The Truth
programme.desc: A scientist (Gregory Harrison) in a colony on another planet urges evacuation when he discovers that a radioactive star will soon pass over. He has been wrong before, though, and at great cost. Will the truth be accepted in time to save the colony?

programme.title: Mary 25
programme.desc: Charlie Bouton (Tom Butler) and Melburn Ross (Michael Shanks) create Mary 25, a nanny robot. When Bouton falls in love with Mary and mistreats his wife, a woman whom Ross once loved, the lines between human and machine become dangerously blurred.

programme.title: Final Exam
programme.desc: A negotiator (Brett Cullen) tries to find out why a grad student (Peter Stebbings) is threatening to detonate a deadly, self-made bomb, unless the government kills five people for him. Why those five people? Is it revenge? And can he be stopped?

programme.title: Teacher's Pet
programme.desc: An attorney for one of Bull's former clients asks him to consult on a couple's civil suit against a teacher who had a sexual relationship with their son; the trial strategy suffers a major setback when the teen switches to the teacher's side.

programme.title: Stockholm Syndrome
programme.desc: The wife of a man whom Danny helped imprison for manslaughter detonates a bomb at the TAC offices and takes the team hostage to force Bull to prove her husband's innocence.

programme.title: Pa'a Ka 'Ipuka i Ka 'Upena Nananana
programme.desc: Five-0 tries to protect a wounded Gabriel and plan an escape when enemy gunmen storm the dilapidated building in which Gabriel is trapped.

programme.title: O Ke Ali'I Wale No Ka'u Makemake
programme.desc: McGarrett and Danny pose as drug pilots in a plan to stop a meth epidemic on the island; Danny is forced to break cover and land the plane when McGarrett is seriously wounded.

programme.title: Makaukau 'oe e Pa'ani?
programme.desc: The team hunts for a murderer who has been targeting serial killers, marking their corpses with an ivory chess piece.

programme.title: No Ke Ali'i Wahine A Me Ka Aina
programme.desc: A rogue MI-6 agent is the key to finding a terrorist who plans to cause the meltdown of nuclear reactors across Europe; McGarrett and Danny need the help of an FBI profiler to find a killer.

programme.title: He Moho Hou
programme.desc: After finding a corpse in her bed, FBI profiler Alicia Brown joins McGarrett in a hunt for a killer; Kono reconnects with a former surfing competitor.

programme.title: Hu A'e Ke Ahi Lanakila A Kamaile
programme.desc: When the serial killer that Alicia and McGarrett have been hunting kidnaps them, it's up to Five-0 to find them before it's too late.

programme.title: Ke Ku 'Ana
programme.desc: A cache of guns is stolen by a person looking to make a statement on gun violence; Kono and Adam are reunited.

programme.title: Ka Hale Ho' Okauweli
programme.desc: On Halloween, the team investigates the murder of a medium who was apparently frightened to death by a poltergeist; a mysterious death cult kidnaps Kono and Adam.

programme.title: Ka Makuahine A Me Ke Keikikane
programme.desc: Catherine informs Five-0 that McGarrett's mother has been captured and is in danger of being executed for trying to free Wo Fat's imprisoned father; Chin is unable to delay Sara's adoption.

programme.title: Hana Komo Pae
programme.desc: While Danny chaperones Grace's high school dance, the venue is seized by terrorists, who hold everyone hostage with the intent of abducting a diplomat's son; Danny and Grover discover that Will is Grace's secret boyfriend.

programme.title: Elua La Ma Nowemapa
programme.desc: A conspiracy theorist with compelling information that JFK's own cabinet planned his assassination is murdered.

programme.title: Ka Luhi
programme.desc: A boy suffering from PTSD undergoes hypnosis and realizes he may have witnessed a murder related to a 10-year-old cold case; Danny's sister visits Oahu.

programme.title: Ka'ili Aku
programme.desc: The team rushes to Mexico, where Chin puts his life in jeopardy in an effort to rescue Sara, his kidnapped niece.

programme.title: Ka 'aelike
programme.desc: When Chin is kidnapped by a Mexican cartel, Five-0 must rescue him before he is executed by the vengeful group; Grover goes undercover to investigate a murder, which turns out to be far more complex and dangerous than anticipated.

programme.title: Hau'oli La Ho'omaika'i
programme.desc: A Secret Service agent is murdered while the president is traveling to Oahu; as Thanksgiving approaches, McGarrett's Aunt Deb (Carol Burnett) visits and shares a stunning secret.

programme.title: Lele Pu Na Manu Like
programme.desc: Grover's parents and brother arrive in Oahu for Thanksgiving; a thief is crushed to death by an empty safe.

programme.title: Ka la'au kumu 'ole o Kahilikolo

programme.desc: Chaplin's first full-length feature is a silent masterpiece about a little tramp who discovers a little orphan and brings him up but is left desolate when the orphanage reclaims him. Chaplin directed, produced and starred in the film, as well as composed the score.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization
programme.desc: Director Penelope Spheeris surveys the late-1970s Los Angeles punk scene: X, Black Flag, Fear, Germs, Catholic Discipline, Alice Bag Band.

programme.title: The Getaway
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Silent Hill: Revelation
programme.desc: For many years, Heather Mason (Adelaide Clemens) and her father, Harry (Sean Bean), have been on the run from dangerous forces she does not understand. Heather continues to be plagued by terrifying nightmares and frightened by her father's disappearance, and on the eve of her 18th birthday, she discovers that she is not who she thinks she is. The revelation leads her deep into the demonic world of Silent Hill, where she may become trapped forever.

programme.title: The Ticket
programme.desc: After James, a blind man, inexplicably regains his vision, he becomes possessed by a drive to make a better life for himself. However, his new improvements -- a nicer home, a higher paying job, tailored suits, luxury car -- leave little room for the people who were part of his old, simpler life. As his relationships buckle under the strain of his snowballing ambition, it becomes uncertain if James can ever return from darkness.

programme.title: Jesus of Nazareth
programme.desc: Jesus' teachings draw large crowds.

programme.title: The Man With the Golden Arm
programme.desc: When illegal card dealer and recovering heroin addict Frankie Machine gets out of prison, he decides to straighten up. Armed with nothing but an old drum set, Frankie tries to get honest work as a drummer. But when his former employer, small-time con man Schwiefka, and Frankie's old drug dealer, Louie, re-enter his life, Frankie finds it hard to stay clean and eventually finds himself succumbing to his old habits.

programme.title: An Eye for an Eye
programme.desc: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

programme.title: Chopper
programme.desc: America had Al Capone; England, the Kray brothers and Australia - proving once and for all its antipodean sense of humor - has Mark "Chopper" Read. "Chopper" is inspired by the books of Mark Brandon "Chopper" Read, arguably Australia's most infamous former criminal. "Chopper" draws on police records, court transcripts, news coverage and interviews with people who knew Chopper Read.

programme.title: The Gambler III: The Legend Continues
programme.desc: An Old West poker player, his partner and a schoolmarm help Dakota Indians thwart a senator's land-grab.

programme.title: The Little Hours
programme.desc: Medieval nuns Alessandra, Fernanda, and Ginevra lead a simple life in their convent. Their days are spent chafing at monastic routine, spying on one another, and berating the estate's day laborer. After a particularly vicious insult session drives the peasant away, Father Tommasso brings on newly hired hand Massetto, a virile young servant forced into hiding by his angry lord. Introduced to the sisters as a deaf-mute to discourage temptation, Massetto struggles to maintain his cover.

programme.title: Filly Brown

programme.title: Abduction

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Starcrash

programme.title: The Kill Room

programme.title: Fifty Shades of Black

The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

The guest of honor is Loren's estranged wife, Annabelle, who, with her secret lover, Dr. Trent, has concocted her own scheme to scare Loren's associate, Nora Manning, into shooting the potentially crazy millionaire. However, more spooks and shocks throw a wrench into the plan.

But when the body of a murdered eight-year-old girl is discovered in the mountains, Jerry offers his expertise at the crime scene. When an ambitious younger cop wrenches a dubious confession from a simple-minded suspect, the case is closed... but not for Jerry.
