programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary.

programme.title: Thief
programme.desc: A master safe cracker plans one last heist for the sake of a woman...and a whole new life.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).

programme.title: Capote
programme.desc: Author Truman Capote embarks upon a journey to write what will become the book of a lifetime.

programme.title: Baby Boom
programme.desc: Diane Keaton shines as a driven career woman who finds her life turned upside down when she "inherits" a baby.

programme.title: Dirty Work
programme.desc: Out of work, but needing cash to fund a surgery, Mitch and his pal use their only natural talent - revenge!

programme.title: Throw Momma From The Train
programme.desc: Funnymen Danny DeVito and Billy Crystal are a momma's boy and a writer who "agree" to swap murders!

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Ruth (Roseanne Barr) doesn't just vow to get her husband back from a romance novelist (Meryl Streep).

programme.title: The French Lieutenant's Woman
programme.desc: Meryl Streep stars in one of the most visually and emotionally stunning love stories ever to grace the screen.

programme.title: Married To The Mob
programme.desc: When her mobster husband is iced by a ruthless kingpin, Angela finds a job in a beauty salon.

programme.title: Raging Bull
programme.desc: Boxer Jake La Motta's life is filled with violence both in out of the ring in this masterpiece.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen roles, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best in this piercing drama.

programme.title: Marty
programme.desc: Ernest Borgnine stars as a butcher who gives up on love -- until he meets an equally lonely school teacher.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

programme.title: Paths Of Glory
programme.desc: A lawyer defends three innocent soldiers who are accused of cowardice as part of a coverup.

programme.title: Cooley High
programme.desc: Two best friends in 1964 Chicago cope with the challenges of everyday life and life in the housing projects.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: When a Valley Girl finds love with a rocker, her girlfriends find him "grody to the max!"

programme.title: The Cutting Edge
programme.desc: The unlikely duo of a retired hockey player and an elitist figure skater go for Olympic gold together.

programme.title: Eight Men Out
programme.desc: The true story of the infamous 1919 Chicago White Sox scandal, when the team throws the World Series.

programme.title: Bull Durham
programme.desc: Baseball season gets off to a rocky start when a veteran catcher and cocky young pitcher compete over a woman.

programme.title: Dead Man Walking
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of a nun's (Susan Sarandon) relationship with a condemned man (Sean Penn).

programme.title: Hotel Rwanda
programme.desc: A hotel manager (Don Cheadle) risks his life and his family to take in over 1,000 refugees during the 1994 Rwandan genocide.

programme.title: Leaving Las Vegas
programme.desc: In this 90s classic, a suicidal, career alcoholic falls for a compassionate Las Vegas hooker.

programme.title: Valley Girl
programme.desc: When a Valley Girl finds love with a rocker, her girlfriends find him "grody to the max!"

programme.title: Dark Secrets
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Echoes of the Dead
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: The Oblong Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The Sleeper Under the Hill
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: The Night of the Stag
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: A Sacred Trust
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: A Rare Bird
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister? Barnaby and Jones attempt to discover the truth.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eleven
programme.desc: When the wife of a wealthy landowner is bludgeoned to death with a cricket bat, DCI Tom Barnaby and his team are enmeshed in a succession of calculating murders. Once again, blackmail, deceit, greed and revenge threaten to destroy Midsomer's tranquillity.

programme.title: Blue Herrings
programme.desc: When the dead body of Muriel Harrap is found late one night at the Lawnside residential home, everyone assumes she died of natural causes. It is not until another seemingly healthy resident dies and rumours of fraud and deception emerge that Alice Bly feels the compulsion to ask her favourite nephew, DCI Tom Barnaby, to investigate.

programme.title: Judgement Day
programme.desc: The locals fear their chances of winning the Perfect Village competition have been dashed when a petty thief is stabbed to death with a pitchfork. Things spiral out of control when two of the competition judges are also murdered, leaving DI Tom Barnaby to track down the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Death of a Stranger
programme.desc: DI Tom Barnaby realises that there is more to a case than first appears when the father of a young poacher, jailed for killing a tramp, is himself brutally murdered.

programme.title: Dance with the Dead
programme.desc: When the body of a young man is found in a WWII-era motor car full of exhaust fumes, it looks like suicide. However, Simon Bright was not alone - as he was hit on the head before he died. Where is his girlfriend, newcomer Laura Sharp? What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: The Animal Within
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: King's Crystal
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: The Axeman Cometh
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Death and Dust
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: A Picture of Innocence
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: They Seek Him Here
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of 'The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Death in a Chocolate Box
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: The Devil's Work
programme.desc: The demise of the Shirewell patriarch sparks a vicious inheritance dispute when eldest son Lucian announces plans to break up an estate that's been in his family for centuries.

programme.title: Book of the Dead
programme.desc: When the author of a book that sparked a nationwide treasure hunt is found dead, Barnaby and Winter must unravel the cryptic clues to find the killer among a group of dedicated seekers.

programme.title: Claws Out
programme.desc: After a pet detective turns up dead inside the kennel of a dog he was searching for, Barnaby and Winter are drawn into the world of dognapping, cat seduction, and animal investigation.

programme.title: A Climate of Death
programme.desc: Sleepy Goodman's Land is known as the Greenest Village in Midsomer. But when the entire village is bought by a Texas oilman, a string of grisly murders ensues.

programme.title: The Village That Rose from the Dead
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby must unravel a sinister web of lies from both past and present in order to catch a killer in the ghost village of Little Auburn.

programme.title: Crime and Punishment
programme.desc: Barnaby learns how far some people will go for power when he investigates the death of a member of the Bleakridge Watch in the most remote village in Midsomer.

programme.title: Last Man Out
programme.desc: Barnaby and Winter investigate the death of a star cricketer during a tournament, but could the dislike of a cricket format really be the motive for murder, or is there more at play.

programme.title: Red in Tooth and Claw
programme.desc: When Barnaby and Winter find a dead body covered in live rabbits, a sinister side to the local pet show is revealed. Is this a case of rivalry taken too far?

programme.title: Death by Persuasion
programme.desc: When a young woman slips away from a camp site where a Jane Austen fantasy event is taking place dressed in period attire, and is found stabbed in the woods with a quill, DCI Barnaby and DS Winter discover that the victim was a journalist interested in the village's healthcare drone delivery programme, and are forced to look back in time to find the killer.

programme.title: The Bonfire of the Vanities
programme.desc: A Wall Street tycoon's hot affair leads to a nightmare hit-and-run trial.

programme.title: Mr. Wonderful
programme.desc: An electrical worker is eager for his ex-wife to get remarried.

programme.title: Greystoke: The Legend of Tarzan, Lord of the Apes
programme.desc: A jungle man is raised from infancy by apes in this wild adventure.

programme.title: Surf Ninjas
programme.desc: Brothers Johnny (Ernie Reyes Jr.) and Adam (Nicolas Cowan) are coasting through a fun surfer existence in Los Angeles when they are suddenly accosted by a band of ninjas. A mysterious warrior comes to their aid, later telling the brothers that they are the royal heirs to the throne of Patusan, an embattled island under the rule of a tyrannical leader (Leslie Nielsen). After discovering their untapped ninja skills, Johnny and Adam agree to travel to Patusan to overthrow the current monarchy.

programme.title: Ladyhawke
programme.desc: Upon breaking out of a dungeon, youthful thief Phillipe Gaston (Matthew Broderick) befriends Capt. Navarre (Rutger Hauer), a man with a strange secret. Navarre and his lover Lady Isabeau d'Anjou (Michelle Pfeiffer) were cursed by the wicked Bishop of Aquila (John Wood), who desires Lady Isabeau for himself. His dark magic prevents the pair from ever being in each other's presence except at twilight, so they enlist Gaston in a dangerous plot to overthrow the Bishop and break his evil enchantment.

programme.title: Deal of the Century
programme.desc: An arms dealer attempts to sell war planes to a South American dictator.

programme.title: The Year of Living Dangerously
programme.desc: An Australian reporter and photographer get more than they'd bargained for.

programme.title: Honeymoon in Vegas
programme.desc: A Las Vegas gambler wins a Hawaii fling with a private eye's bride-to-be.

programme.title: Strange Brew
programme.desc: In their quest for free beer, bumbling Canadian brothers Bob (Rick Moranis) and Doug McKenzie (Dave Thomas) wind up working at the Elsinore Brewery. The hapless lads uncover a sinister mind-control plot spearheaded by Brewmeister Smith (Max von Sydow) and must stop the scheme, which also involves Uncle Claude (Paul Dooley), a member of the Elsinore family. As Bob and Doug try to prevent Smith from taking over the world, they also manage to drink plenty of their favorite sudsy beverage.

programme.title: Fathers' Day
programme.desc: Jack (Billy Crystal) is a straitlaced lawyer with a loving wife (Julia Louis-Dreyfus). Dale (Robin Williams) is suicidal about his stalled career as an artist. The only thing they have in common is Colette (Nastassja Kinski), with whom they both had an affair years ago. Unbeknownst to the two men, she had a son, Scott (Charlie Hofheimer), who is now missing. After she tells Jack and Dale that one of them could be the father, the pair set out to find Scott and prove who the real father is.

programme.title: 16 Blocks
programme.desc: A world-weary cop must outwit rogue officers planning to kill a witness.

programme.title: Lone Star
programme.desc: A dead body reopens old wounds in a small Texas border town.

programme.title: Presumed Innocent
programme.desc: A prosecutor is accused of killing his co-worker and former lover.

programme.title: Fandango
programme.desc: Gardner Barnes is a young Texan who has just graduated from college and is unsure of what to do next. Along with his friends, collectively known as the Groovers, Gardner embarks on a road trip to the Rio Grande as a last hurrah for the group. As the trip progresses, Gardner and his buddies, including Kenneth Waggener and Phil Hicks, struggle with their impending adulthood and the looming issue of the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Preacher's Kid
programme.desc: After joining a traveling show, Angie discovers life on the road is tough.

programme.title: Protocol
programme.desc: A waitress bumbles into a job with the diplomatic corps in the Middle East.

programme.title: Corrina, Corrina
programme.desc: A family devastated by grief meets a woman who helps heal the loss.

programme.title: Mr. Nanny
programme.desc: Former wrestler Sean Armstrong (Terry "Hulk" Hogan) takes a job as bodyguard and nanny to Alex Jr. (Robert Gorman) and Kate (Madeline Zima), the children of Alex Mason (Austin Pendleton). The kids receive little attention from their father and take out their energy in pranks on their babysitters. Despite their initial hostility, Sean and the children soon bond. When criminal Tommy Thanatos (David Johansen) kidnaps the kids to get his hands on a new computer chip, Sean must rescue them.

programme.title: Overnight Delivery
programme.desc: Friends have 24 hours to stop a package, prevent disaster and fall in love.

programme.title: Matchstick Men
programme.desc: Roy (Nicolas Cage), a depressed con artist with obsessive-compulsive disorder, and Frank (Sam Rockwell), his partner, find their line of work complicated by the arrival of Roy's teenage daughter, Angela (Alison Lohman). Angela brings some spirit back into Roy's life, and some of his disorder symptoms seem to disappear. But when Angela wants to learn the family business, and Roy allows her to assist on a big scam concerning a businessmen (Bruce McGill), he reconsiders his parenting techniques.

programme.title: Victor/Victoria
programme.desc: A cabaret singer finds fame when she goes on stage as female impersonator.

programme.title: Alex & Me
programme.desc: A poster of soccer star Alex Morgan magically comes to life.

programme.title: Her Alibi
programme.desc: Mystery novelist Phil Blackwood has written countless bestsellers, but he's having trouble finding inspiration for his latest book, so he goes to the courthouse to observe real criminals in action. There he encounters Nina, a gorgeous immigrant charged with a gruesome murder. Convinced she's not guilty, Phil furnishes Nina with an alibi and a place to stay. But, as the two begin to fall in love, Phil finds he has grave doubts about her innocence.

programme.title: Little Children
programme.desc: A small town hides a sordid underbelly of adultery and perversion.

programme.title: The Accidental Tourist
programme.desc: A travel writer hates to travel and loves order, until everything changes.

programme.title: War of the Worlds
programme.desc: Civilization is laid to ruin when a super-race of aliens invade Earth. Massive walkers cover the planet annihilating all in their path as cities crumble.

programme.title: Ape vs. Mecha Ape
programme.desc: Recognizing the power of its captive giant Ape, the military makes its own battle-ready, Mecha Ape. But its first practical test goes horribly wrong, leaving the military no choice but to release the giant Ape to stop the robot.

programme.title: Down the Mississippi
programme.desc: Our Heroes try to cross the Mississippi but are involved in a boating accident. 10K is rescued by Sketchy and Skeezy and they offer to take him in if he'll help them out with their latest scam.

programme.title: 2010 Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: Doc Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
programme.desc: Doc finds himself taken captive by a psychotic nurse and her surviving mental patients in an homage to "One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest" but with Zombies. Doc discovers that 10K is also being held prisoner by the lunatics.

programme.title: 2010 Moby Dick
programme.desc: A modern adaptation of the classic novel of the captain of a high tech submarine and his obsessive quest to destroy the enormous prehistoric whale that maimed him.

programme.title: 100 Million BC
programme.desc: During the 1940s, government scientist Dr. Frank Reno (Michael Gross) lost a platoon of American soldiers in a botched time-travel experiment. When a rescue team transports the survivors -- including Reno's brother, Erik (Christopher Atkins) -- from prehistoric times to 2008, they unwittingly allow an uninvited guest to follow them. Now, a desperate group of modern Navy SEALs and their World War II-era counterparts must stop a vicious Tyrannosaurus rex from ravaging the streets of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Alien Convergence
programme.desc: When flying reptilian creatures wreak havoc all over the world, the survivors' only hope of stopping them is a new, state-of-the-art fighter jet piloted by the only team that knows how to use the technology.

programme.title: Zoombies 2
programme.desc: A game ranger arrests poachers, only to save them when zombie animals attack. Trapped in the zoo, the ranger and poachers must form an uneasy alliance to stop the beasts from spreading a super-zombie virus to the world.

programme.title: Independents' Day
programme.desc: After aliens invade earth and destroy all our nuclear arsenal, they give us a choice: either emigrate to a new, better planet or be killed. While most earthlings resign themselves to leaving, the president of the United States turns to a rogue militia to fight back and expose the truth before the human race is obliterated.

programme.title: Monster Island
programme.desc: As the world tries to stop a giant Kaiju bent on destruction more and more monsters appear - each one more terrible than the last - leaving mankind defenseless until our heroes reach out to a specialist versed in monster lore.

programme.title: Planetquake
programme.desc: A tectonic shift, deep below the Mariana Trench, causes a series of ever-escalating earthquakes. If a team of leading seismologists fails to stop the mounting terror, the disastrous events threaten to break apart the Earth.

programme.title: Apocalypse Pompeii
programme.desc: A former Special Ops commando enlists his old teammates for a mission to rescue his wife and daughter, who have become trapped by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: The California coast is terrorized by two enormous prehistoric sea creatures as they battle each other for supremacy of the sea.

programme.title: Welcome to Murphytown
programme.desc: Seemingly injected with the Blend vaccine, The Man attempts to kidnap Murphy but underestimates the strength of Murphy's followers. Elsewhere in the Apocalypse, 10K is back with the Heroes.

programme.title: Heart of Darkness
programme.desc: Warren realizes she must go to the dark side to defeat Murphy and stop the Blend Army he is creating. Against the advice of Hector and Sun Mei, Warren goes in search of the elusive "Escorpion," and the Red Hand.

programme.title: 3 Headed Shark Attack
programme.desc: The world's greatest killing machine is three times as deadly when a mutated shark threatens a cruise ship. As the shark eats its way from one end of the ship to the next, the passengers fight the deadly predator using anything they can find.

programme.title: AVH: Alien vs. Hunter
programme.desc: A galactic hunter chases the most dangerous alien creature in the universe to planet Earth, where humanity is caught between predator and prey.

programme.title: Death Racers
programme.desc: This action thriller takes a grim vision of the future where brutality is a virtue and mercy will cost your life. In this race, contestants participate in a cross-country road race where killing is how you win the game

programme.title: 666: The Beast
programme.desc: Donald Lawson (Chad Mathews), the son of Satan, is working as a vice president at a large corporation. Donald doesn't know he's the antichrist, but his satanist boss (Collin Brock) is dedicated to helping Donald fulfill his destiny. Meanwhile, Father Cain (Amol Shah), a Vatican agent, visits Donald's pregnant wife (Makinna Ridgway), as she's destined to give birth to the second coming of Jesus Christ. But, in order for that to happen, Father Cain must destroy Donald.

programme.title: White Light
programme.desc: Murphy manages to give our Heroes the slip yet again. Vasquez, at first interested only in bagging Murphy for himself, starts to see the value in working with our Heroes rather than against them.

programme.title: Avengers Grimm
programme.desc: When Rumpelstiltskin destroys the Magic Mirror and escapes to the modern world, the four princesses of Once Upon a Time-Cinderella, Sleeping Beauty, Snow White, and Rapunzel-are sucked through the portal too. Well-trained and endowed with magical powers, they must fight Rumpelstiltskin and his army of thralls before he enslaves everyone on earth.

programme.title: Limbo
programme.desc: Warren and the gang find Limbo and are reunited with an old friend. Murphy and his band of Blends runs the casino there which also serves as a sanctuary for the Talkers.

programme.title: Party with the Zeros
programme.desc: Our Heroes are captured by the Zeros and they meet the Queen of the Zeros, "La Reina." She tells them she is paving the way for her own form of democracy. Impressed with our Heroes, La Reina invites them to join her team.

programme.title: 2025 Armageddon
programme.desc: A militant alien race launches an attack on Earth using gigantic creatures and geological disasters all based on those found on The Asylum's Movie Channel. Earth scientists are forced to create other monsters to fight back.

programme.title: Lord of the Elves
programme.desc: In an ancient age, the peace-loving tribe are enslaved by a race of flesh-eating dragon-riders. The young tribesmen Goben must join forces with their neighbor giants, the humans, to free his people and vanquish their enemies.

programme.title: Dracula's Curse
programme.desc: The peaceful world where vampires and humans live side by side, explodes into a bloody battle when Countess Bathorly and her family of deadly vampires believe they possess the power of Count Draclula himself.

programme.title: Almighty Thor
programme.desc: When the demon god Loki destroys the fortress of Valhalla and steals the Hammer of Invincibility, only the young hero Thor can protect Earth from armageddon.

programme.title: Back From The Undead
programme.desc: Lucy brings Murphy back from his Mad Zombie-state. Meanwhile, Warren, Doc, 10K and Sarge battle a biologically modified Franken-Zombie guarding a clue to Warren's dream.

programme.title: 2012: Doomsday
programme.desc: Four strangers on a journey of faith are drawn to a temple in the heart of Mexico on December 21, 2012. For the Mayans it is the last recorded day. For NASA scientists it is a cataclysmic polar shift. For the rest of us, it is Doomsday.

programme.title: Nazi Overlord
programme.desc: Against the background of the D-Day invasion, a US military unit must rescue a brilliant British scientist, who is held captive by the most dangerous SS guards, deep in enemy territory. The Allies' victory depends on the success of this mission.

programme.title: Hold Your Breath
programme.desc: A group of friends on a roadtrip explore a cemetery where the ghost of a notorious serial killer jumps from body to body, killing his victims one by one.

programme.title: Mega Shark Vs Giant Octopus
programme.desc: The California coast is terrorized by two enormous prehistoric sea creatures as they battle each other for supremacy of the sea.

programme.title: High Impact
programme.desc: Nash and Joe Dominguez try to protect the mayor when a religious fanatic takes fire and brimstone seriously and detonates bombs all over San Francisco.

programme.title: The Javelin Catcher
programme.desc: A deadly military weapon stolen by gang members leads Nash to work with a military adviser before more gang violence erupts.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: When a sting operation falls apart and Harvey Leek disappears with the government's money, Joe and Nash set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aloha, Nash
programme.desc: Nash puts his romantic vacation with Kelly on hold to pursue the evils behind an incriminating betting book; Ian's girlfriend is taken hostage.

programme.title: Key Witness
programme.desc: Nash sets out to help Lisa, whose eyewitness account of a murder raises some eyebrows when no body can be found; Joe checks out his new investment.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Nash must clear his name after being suspended following an Internal Affairs accusation that he murdered a suspect in revenge.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Joe is exposed to a deadly virus after a thief unwittingly releases it into the air while foraging for drugs at a chemical lab.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Nash's daughter, Cassidy, is kidnapped by an escaped anti-government extremist who is out to avenge his imprisonment and separation from his family.

programme.title: Wrecking Crew
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are taken hostage while attempting to nab a gang of professional thieves during a robbery.

programme.title: Trackdown
programme.desc: Nash attempts to apprehend a former best friend who has become an international mercenary sent to San Francisco for a hit.

programme.title: The Brothers McMillan
programme.desc: Dead bodies begin surfacing as two brothers vie for control of the Irish mafia in San Francisco; Joe suspects someone is stealing from his bar.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Nash and his team take the subway home from a bachelor party and are held hostage after walking into the midst of a robbery.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Nash calls on his former mentor, Dale Cutter, for help in a murder case that has all the signs of the infamous Zodiac killings.

programme.title: Leo's Big Score
programme.desc: Nash baby-sits a juvenile felon marked for death by drug dealers; Joe gives his son J.J. a job at the bar.

programme.title: Hit Parade
programme.desc: A money launderer-turned-informant is killed, and Nash and Joe discover they are next in line unless they can find the hit man first.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: A student accused of attempted murder leads Nash and Joe to a Chinese slavery ring smuggling illegal immigrants into the country.

programme.title: 25 Hours of Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is put on hold as Nash and Joe investigate the death of a store executive murdered at the site of a professional jewelry heist.

programme.title: Road Work
programme.desc: An information leak linked to the government endangers the lives of Nash and Joe, and the federal witness they must protect.

programme.title: Inside Out
programme.desc: Joe infiltrates a prison when all the evidence in the murder of an undercover police officer points to an incarcerated drug lord.

programme.title: The Counterfeiters
programme.desc: Nash and Joe discover that a group is impersonating the Special Investigations Unit in order to pull off a $20 million counterfeit heist.

programme.title: The Web
programme.desc: Nash and Joe learn that a hacker is stealing prototype computer equipment to pay the ransom on his kidnapped wife.

programme.title: Knockout
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for the perpetrators of a series of sex crimes when Nash's sister, Stacy, becomes a victim and can't remember anything about the attack.

programme.title: Gun Play
programme.desc: While Cassidy recuperates after being struck by a stray bullet, Nash and Joe look for both the shooter and the gun supplier.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Inspector Robbins wants Nash and Joe to track down his teenage daughter who has joined a convicted felon on a crime spree.

programme.title: Out of Chicago
programme.desc: A beautiful Chicago detective helps Nash and Joe investigate a triple murder; Joe calls a hypnotist for a melancholy racehorse.

programme.title: Moving Target
programme.desc: Searching for a criminal puts Nash and Joe in competition with a bounty hunter who used to be Nash's boss.

programme.title: Wild Card
programme.desc: While eluding a Florida gangster, a former partner enlists Nash's help in finding the man who cheated him in a poker game.

programme.title: Deliverance
programme.desc: Nash and Joe learn that drug dealers are being executed by a commando hired to protect an urban community.

programme.title: Lost and Found
programme.desc: An explosive encounter with carjackers puts Nash on their trail and into conflict with a policewoman who believes he's compromised her undercover investigation.

programme.title: Payback
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) spring a convict (guest star Willie Nelson) from San Quentin so the ex-biker can lead them to a murder suspect (guest star Tobin Bell).

programme.title: Shake, Rattle and Roll
programme.desc: Babysitters Nash and Joe must stop a hit man; Nick has an unsuitable love interest (Jennifer O'Neill).

programme.title: One Flew Over the 'Cuda's Nest
programme.desc: An escaped mental patient goes on a literary killing spree; Joe and Inger regret hiring Nash's baby-nurse friend.

programme.title: Blackout
programme.desc: Nash (Don Johnson) finds a murder case much more difficult to crack after a bomb blast gives him amnesia. With Cheech Marin.

programme.title: Ripcord
programme.desc: A burglar escapes by leaping from the 35th floor with a parachute; Nick volunteers for an experimental program at the university.

programme.title: Sniper
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track a sniper in San Francisco; a social club celebrates Halloween daily; guest Cassandra Peterson, "Elvira."

programme.title: Revelations
programme.desc: A clash between rival drug lords uncovers new evidence on the whereabouts of Nash's missing brother, presumed killed in the Vietnam War.

programme.title: Most Wanted
programme.desc: A convict inadvertently released by county officers targets Michelle; a TV reporter is being blackmailed.

programme.title: Bombshell
programme.desc: Mobsters and federal agents pursue Nash's old flame; Joe films a salsa commercial in Nash's apartment.

programme.title: Found Money
programme.desc: Bettina sets out to be a tough boss, accusing Joe of stealing $3 million from a car stopped after an armed pursuit.

programme.title: Dirty Tricks
programme.desc: A convicted murderer's escape on his way to his sentencing hearing leads Nash and Joe to the British Consulate.

programme.title: Crossfire
programme.desc: A convicted arsonist (Mark Rolston) uses outside contacts to keep Nash (Don Johnson) from testifying at his parole hearing. With Cheech Marin.

programme.title: Live Shot
programme.desc: Nash gets drugged during a bust just before he and Joe are scheduled to recount their careers for Geraldo's cameras.

programme.title: Downtime
programme.desc: A forced vacation has Nash and Joe working outside conventional channels to solve a string of armored car robberies.

programme.title: Skin Deep
programme.desc: Nash clashes with a visiting New York detective over the handling of a stalker case; Evan loses his badge during a one-night stand.

programme.title: Patriots
programme.desc: The Irish husband of Nash's first ex-wife is in San Francisco looking for revenge against IRA terrorists.

programme.title: Cuda Grace
programme.desc: Drug-related murders lead to a millionaire; Evan and Bettina go undercover at a transgender beauty pageant; guest RuPaul.

programme.title: Lady Killer
programme.desc: Nash tries to figure out who is framing Bettina for murder; someone is using Joe's stolen credit cards to live the playboy lifestyle.

programme.title: Danger Zone
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) learn that a truckload of nerve gas is about to be released in downtown San Francisco.

programme.title: Special Delivery
programme.desc: Nash must protect Lynette from Asian mobsters when she unknowingly becomes involved in a forgery ring; Joe's father visits.

programme.title: Touchdown
programme.desc: Several armored cars and their drivers disappear; a football star needs to find "the most beautiful girl in the world"; Nick is reluctant to use a hearing aid.

programme.title: Sacraments
programme.desc: Metal heads go on a crime spree; Nash learns of Cassidy and Evan's relationship; Nick gets an overdue Navy Cross.

programme.title: High Fall
programme.desc: Nash's ex-lover masterminds a real estate scam that leaves him destitute; Joe destroys his own home while trying to improve it.

programme.title: Impostors
programme.desc: Nash and Joe pose as gay detectives in San Francisco's Castro district while trying to find a Cher impersonator's stolen wig.

programme.title: Hot Prowler
programme.desc: Nash and Joe search for a psychopath who telecasts videotapes of his crimes on the Internet; Joe considers suing a restaurant.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: Killing Season
programme.desc: Oscar winner Robert De Niro ("Raging Bull") and Oscar nominee John Travolta ("Pulp Fiction") star as two Bosnian War veterans hunting each other in this thrilling game of cat and mouse.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Fake the Money and Run
programme.desc: Ed tries to keep the new boss out of the loop while he figures out who has been making counterfeit chips; Danny's accountant suggests he sell his father's house and refers him to an attractive real estate agent (Rachael Leigh Cook).

programme.title: Double Down, Triple Threat
programme.desc: When a card counter's daughter is kidnapped, Danny, Mike and Ed reunite with Dr. Cavanaugh (Jill Hennessy) to solve the high-stakes crime.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Seymour Magoon?
programme.desc: Danny and Penny's relationship hits new levels; Jillian sprains her ankle and convinces Ed to walk the family dog at a local show; Mike must rescue Monica from her shower.

programme.title: The Big Ed De-cline
programme.desc: Ed's plan to rid himself of undue stress ends when he discovers he is a victim of identity theft.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Despite Mike and Mary's warnings, Danny locates the mystery woman who appears in photos with his father and offers to pay her medical expenses.

programme.title: Everything Old Is You Again
programme.desc: Danny has a flashback to 1962 and being director of entertainment at the Jubilee Hotel and Casino.

programme.title: Bold, Beautiful and Blue
programme.desc: Danny, Monica and FBI Agent Portis review the security measures being taken to protect the Kashmir Sapphire, a priceless gemstone on loan and display at the Montecito.

programme.title: Mothwoman
programme.desc: When the Montecito hosts a comic book convention, fans mistake Monica (Lara Flynn Boyle) for the comic book heroine Mothwoman.

programme.title: For Sail by Owner
programme.desc: A stunning change of events thwarts a hostile takeover of the Montecito; a thug mugs Mike, who leaves Danny to seek his revenge.

programme.title: Down and Dirty
programme.desc: During a nationally televised poker tournament, Danny and Mike suspect someone is cheating and investigate security footage, despite protests from the show's producer.

programme.title: Bait and Switch

When an ambitious prosecutor brings him back to court, he decides to defend himself. Initially regarded with disbelief, his forceful presence and knowledge of the law turn the tide of the trial.

programme.title: Life of a King
programme.desc: An ex-felon on a path of redemption defies convention and establishes a Chess Club for inner-city teenagers.

programme.title: In Hell
programme.desc: Kyle LeBlanc is an honorable citizen who winds up incarcerated in Russia after he takes revenge on the man who murdered his wife, resulting in the killer's death. Unfortunately for Kyle, he is assigned to a prison that is renowned for its violence. Controlled by a corrupt and sadistic warden, the facility regularly holds brutal fights between inmates. In order to survive in the prison, Kyle must participate in the battles, even as he attempts to retain his humanity.

programme.title: Labyrinth

He sets out to try to find a shard of the dark crystal, a powerful gem that once provided balance to the universe. After the crystal was broken, the evil Skeksis used sinister means to gain control. Jen believes that he can repair the dark crystal and bring peace back to the world, if he can only find the remaining shard.

programme.title: FernGully: The Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home

Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: London Has Fallen
programme.desc: When a national day of mourning in London for a fallen leader turns into a horrific terrorist attack, the clock begins ticking for Mike Banning, a seasoned Secret Service agent, and President Asher. What starts as a solemn funeral quickly devolves into chaos as heavily armed insurgents storm the event, resulting in unprecedented violence across the city. Banning, determined to save the President, navigates through a landscape filled with misinformation and danger, uncovering a deeper conspiracy led by the vengeful arms dealer Aamir Barkawi, whose ties to global terrorism threaten more than just the safety of those physically present. With the breakdown of communication channels and infiltration of key security measures, the protagonist must rely on quick thinking and adrenaline-fueled action to outsmart the enemy. The lives of countless civilians are at stake as Banning engages in a tense battle against time, aiming not only to rescue the President but also to dismantle a profoundly dangerous network designed to sow chaos and destruction worldwide. As the crisis unfolds, it becomes more than just a fight for survival; it's a terrifying examination of the fragility of peace and the price of freedom in a convoluted world.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: In this first season finale, the Metalocalypse creeps closer to fulfillment when Dethklok executes their most brutal performance to date, and the Tribunal finally makes their move.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Since Dethklok's withdrawal from the public following the purported Dethwater Live "fan attack", the world economy teeters on the brink of disaster. Dethklok is finally lured back into the outside world with their protective "pelvic-thrust mace belts" to be a part of the world's largest public execution of criminals in recorded history.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Toki Wartooth is fed up playing in the shadow of Skwisgaar's lead guitar. Under the tutelage of a crusty old guitar master, Toki learns that the heart, too, has strings.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The wounded, the scared, and the disfigured unite. Meanwhile, an oblivious Dethklok spends their studio time recording onto the purest of all analog formats: water.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Fearing for their safety after a public gun mishap/bloodbath, the CFO hires look-a-likes of Dethklok to make public appearances while the band prepares for a Duncan Hills Coffee promotional event.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When promoting a new clothing line, Dethklok experiences the brutality of negative body image, dieting, and bulimia.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dr. Rockzo, the Rock n Roll Clown, gets help from Dethklok to overcome his cocaine addition and come c-c-c-clean!

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Metal meets mid-west etiquette when Pickles' brother, Seth, invites Dethklok to his Wisconsin wedding.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Pickles' popularity soars when he gets a personal P.R. agent, prompting the rest of Dethklok to form a rival P.R. firm. Meanwhile, Pickles' P.R. woman has dark, otherworldy, and religious motives behind her Evil Press Releases.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok travels to the Amazon where they learn about native brutality from the Yannemango Indians.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Nathan Explosion serves an emergency term as temporary governor for the state of Florida, sending Florida into a state of further emergency.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: William Murderface creates the "Nascar-type Theatrical Hybrid Event" and takes all creative and logistical control upon himself. Nathan and Pickles try to be supportive of their overwhelmed pal, while Skwisgaar and Toki attempt to get their driver licenses.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Nathan learns that his ex-girlfriend, Rebecca Nightrod, has already found new love while still in a coma, he decides to return to the dating scene. Unfortunately, the rest of the band makes it difficult for Nathan to make a true love connection.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The band is fed up with Offdenson knowing more than they do. They want their fifth of everything and decide to hire an efficiency expert to tighten up matters at Mordhaus and maximize their weekly allowance.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: When Toki gets news that his dad is dying, he's forced to travel back to his home town in Norway. The rest of the band decides to make a vacation out of it, citing "album inspiration" as their excuse to further put off working on their delayed album.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: The world economy is crumbling and waiting for the next Dethklok album to stimulate it back into order. It's up to Dethklok to get the album just right and finished on time.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After the attack on Mordhaus, Dethklok is left without a manager and plagued by greedy record execs and forced to face the brutality of the slumping economy while dabbling in interior design. Will they spend everything and sign a deal that will render them powerless? Or worse, will they allow Murderface to turn the living room into an Arizona-styled sandscape?

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: Dethklok joins their own Dethklok tribute band as a last ditch effort to connect with their rock and roll roots.

programme.title: Metalocalypse
programme.desc: After a near-death experience, Dethklok realizes they would rather be sick and not know then face the brutality of going to a doctor. After home remedies including drinking bleach, Dethklok learns that their ultimate fear will be realized, one of them has a terminal illness. Meanwhile Nathan tries to brave the brutality of going to the dentist and Murderface faces the possibility of being gay after accidentally ejaculating on a doctors face. Part of Season 3.

Doc and Brock become the unwitting pawns in a low-grade pissing contest when Phantom Limb's sics the Guild's commandos on the Venture compound to prove his dominance. Can Brock hold off an army? Can Doc escape death and finish watching the worst porno ever?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: I Know Why the Caged Bird Kills

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Shadowman 9: In the Cradle of Destiny

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

What could Pete White have been hiding from him for all these years? And why is Brock in on the cover-up?

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Hate is

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

And the Quymn's bodyguard, Ginnie, is hot for Brock. Maybe. But all of their romantic interludes will have to be put aside when the terror of the Wereodile threatens their camp.

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The
programme.sub-title: What Goes Down Must Come Up
programme.desc: All basements are kinda spooky, but the Ventures are about to learn the hard way that beneath the foundations of the Venture Compound lie deep, dark secrets... great and small. programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

programme.title: Venture Brothers, The

Unfortunately, he invited all of his father's surviving friends and enemies to the grand opening. There's nothing like a party to stir up decades worth of sibling rivalries, bitter regrets and half-forgotten hatreds.

programme.sub-title: Blood of the Father, Heart of Steel

programme.title: Paying the Price
programme.desc: In ARRANGED, three couples from different cultural backgrounds have one thing in common-- the belief in arranged marriages. From a Romani gypsy couple in New York City, to a southern couple from the Bible belt, to a couple raised by traditional Eastern Indian parents living in Los Angeles-- these brides and grooms don't just marry each other, their unions include their entire family. Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

Viewers will see each couple's relationship from the lead-up to their weddings to the several months after the reality of married life sinks in.

programme.desc: When scientist Dr. Carrington (Robert Cornthwaite) reports a UFO near his North Pole research base, the Air Force sends in a team under Capt. They bring their discovery back to the base, but Carrington and Hendry disagree over what to do with it. Meanwhile, the creature is accidentally thawed and begins wreaking havoc.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a comet causes a radiation storm on Earth, machines come to life and turn against their makers. A diner cook, Bill Robinson (Emilio Estevez), emerges as the unlikely leader of the pack, attempting to find an escape plan for himself and the survivors, who include his boss, Bubba Hendershot (Pat Hingle), and a newlywed couple.

programme.title: The Veil
programme.desc: Boris Karloff, the master of horror, hosts a macabre collection of strange stories (all based on "true" incidents) in this rarely-seen series that was intended for television back in 1958. Made a few years before Karloff's better-known "Thriller" show, "The Veil" featured the veteran actor performing in many of the chilling episodes in a variety of creepy roles. While the program was never aired, some of its episodes were plucked and edited into feature-length movies that were sold to television, reminiscent of theatrical releases like Tales From The Crypt and The Vault Of Horror. Exceptionally entertaining and well-made, The Veil evokes the same type of edge-of-your-seat thrills as The Twilight Zone and One Step Beyond.
